biography: Claude Dégremont's journey began not in the gleaming paddocks of Formula 1, but amidst the sun-drenched vineyards of southern France. Growing up near Le Castellet, the roar of engines at Circuit Paul Ricard was the soundtrack to his childhood. Instead of tractors, young Claude dreamt of racing cars, spending hours tinkering with go-karts in his uncle's garage. His breakthrough came unexpectedly at 18, winning a local karting championship against seasoned veterans. This victory caught the eye of a Ligier academy scout, who offered him a spot in their junior program. Dégremont quickly proved his worth, showcasing raw speed and an unapologetically aggressive style in the Ligier JS2 R series. Now, at 23, Claude is a rising star, eager to prove himself on a bigger stage, hoping to make a splash in the world of endurance racing.
drivingStyle: Dégremont's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos.' He possesses a natural talent for extracting maximum performance from his car, often pushing the limits of grip in corners. While his aggressive approach can sometimes lead to mistakes, it also allows him to make daring overtakes and maintain blistering pace. Tire management is an area where he needs improvement, as his relentless pursuit of speed can sometimes lead to premature wear. However, under pressure, Dégremont thrives, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest.

rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor since their karting days, Isabelle and Claude have a history of close battles and controversial incidents on track.
Dubois, a veteran Ligier driver, sees Dégremont as a threat to his position and has openly criticized his aggressive style.
Bellini, an Italian driver known for his defensive driving, has clashed with Dégremont on several occasions, resulting in heated on-track duels.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of driving gloves, a gift from his grandmother.
Listens to classical music before each race to calm his nerves.
Studies onboard footage of his rivals meticulously, searching for any potential weaknesses.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about pushing yourself to the absolute limit and beyond."
careerHighlight: Winning the Circuit Paul Ricard Ligier JS2 R race in front of his hometown crowd, overcoming a mid-race puncture to secure victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Spa-Francorchamps race due to overzealousness, costing him a potential championship.
